reason: A DeepSeek Harness appearance plugin for customizing theme colors, wallpapers, dynamic backgrounds, and per-component opacity and blur, with local persistence and theme import/export.

summaries.zh: 用于自定义 DeepSeek Harness 界面主题色、图片或视频壁纸、动态背景以及各界面部分透明度和模糊度的外观插件。
summaries.en: An appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness that customizes theme colors, image or video wallpapers, dynamic backgrounds, and per-component opacity and blur.

capabilities: customizes Web UI theme colors and appearance
adjusts interface opacity and blur by component
persists settings and media on the local filesystem
imports and exports theme configuration files
provides an HTTP route for video streaming within the plugin
